sentences.text: Pucabatis was a prehistoric member of the class Chondrichthyes, which includes sharks and rays.
This animal belongs to the family Rhombodontidae.
Fossils of Pucabatis have been discovered in the El Molino Formation in Bolivia and the Bagua Formation in Peru.
The genus Pucabatis was named by Cappetta in 1975.
The only known species of this genus is Pucabatis hoffstetteri.
Pucabatis was a prehistoric ray that lived during the Maastrichtian stage.
The genus existed from the Campanian to the Maastrichtian, between 83.6 and 66 million years ago.
